mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user account JOIN sys_tenant owner ON owner.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND owner.deleted = 0 AND owner.status = '0' JOIN sys_tenant target ON target.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND target.deleted = 0 AND target.status = '0' WHERE account.tenant_id = #{ownerTenantId} AND account.user_id = #{userId} AND account.version = #{userVersion} AND account.deleted = 0 AND account.status = '0' AND (owner.expire_time IS NULL OR owner.expire_time > NOW()) AND (target.expire_time IS NULL OR target.expire_time > NOW()) AND (#{ownerTenantId} = #{tenantId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role binding JOIN sys_role role_row ON role_row.role_id = binding.role_id AND role_row.tenant_id = #{ownerTenantId} WHERE binding.tenant_id = #{ownerTenantId} AND binding.user_id = #{userId} AND role_row.status = '0' AND role_row.deleted = 0 AND role_row.role_key = 'admin' )) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_im_sync_run sync_run WHERE sync_run.tenant_id IN (#{ownerTenantId}, #{tenantId}) AND sync_run.mode = 'APPLY' AND sync_run.status = 'RUNNING' AND (COALESCE(JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(sync_run.result_summary, '$.effectsPending')), 'NULL') != 'BOOLEAN' OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(sync_run.result_summary, '$.effectsPending')) != 'false') )
